Kansas Corporation Commission
                                 Commission Meeting
                            September 17, 2026 @ 10:00 am
                  KCC Offices, 1500 SW Arrowhead Rd., Topeka, Kansas

                                       MINUTES

The Commission convened the regularly scheduled open meeting of the Commission at 10:00 am
on September 17, 2026, at the Kansas Corporation Commission, 1500 SW Arrowhead Road,
Topeka, Kansas.

Present: Commissioner Keen and Commissioner Kuether. Chairperson French was absent. The
following were considered by the Commission:
     1.   Consent Agenda: Commissioner Kuether moved for approval of the Consent Agenda
          dated September 17, 2026. The Consent Agenda contains pages one through ten and
          is attached to the Minutes. Commissioner Keen seconded the motion.

          The motion was approved.




                                       Page 1 of 2
     There being no further matters before the Commission, Commissioner Kuether moved for
    adjournment of the Commission meeting. Commissioner Keen seconded the motion. The
    Commission adjourned the September 17, 2026, Commission Meeting at 10:01 am.




                                                              Absent
                                                              Andrew J. French, Chair




                                                              Dwight D. Keen, Commissioner




Attest:


          Jesse R. Becker, Executive Director                 Annie Kuether, Commissioner




                                                Page 2 of 2
                                                                                           ITEMS OF
                                                                                      Consent Agenda
                                                                        Approval Date: September 17, 2026




NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC: There will be no separate discussion of Consent Agenda items as they are
considered to be routine by the Kansas Corporation Commission. Unless removed from the website's Consent
Agenda, the orders appearing on the Consent Agenda will become the Order of the full Commission at the
Commission’s regularly scheduled Business Meeting. If Commission staff or a Commissioner requests an item
be removed from the Consent Agenda, the affected item may be considered separately or placed on the earliest
possible Business Meeting agenda for discussion.
